Counting back on a number line was practised; 0 of 1 attempts was unaided correct, with more checking needed next time.
Kabir counted the starting number as the first step once, giving one too many; this was not corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised subtraction stories within 9 and counting back on a number line with Kabir. They used answers such as five, three, and four during the practice. Kabir sometimes counted the starting number as the first step, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, use a line of 5–9 objects: remove some, then point to the starting number and make each jump count as one step.
